residual.conditional: Only if alignment insufficient AND both Train/Val support pass

residual.selection: step200/400/600 Val loss; fixedthreshold.2; stop at budget

sampling.uniform: equal extra count deterministic evenly spaced S4 ray indices
sampling.denominator: all native reliable target reference; includes ROI missed Actors
